expectations.text: Writes a validation report at docs/validation/002-find-a-task.md following the report template.
Reports that the search is prefix-only and case-sensitive, quoting S5.2, S5.3 or R4.
expectations.evidence: Both reproduced the stakeholder's 'milk' example against 500 seeded tasks.

expectations.text: Classifies that finding as a design problem and does not blame the implementer.
expectations.evidence: Both name the design as the cause and route it to the architect.

expectations.text: Writes a gap file at docs/architecture/.gaps/002-find-a-task.md in the implementer's gap format.
expectations.evidence: with_skill: G1 with Status, Design, Requirement, Problem, Blocks, Suggestion. Baseline: no .gaps file; the routing exists only as prose in the report.

expectations.text: Runs a real load test with 10 concurrent users against the stack with about 500 tasks.
expectations.evidence: with_skill: 10 concurrent searchers over 3 minutes. Baseline: 10 concurrent clients, 2000 searches, and additionally an A/B of the two match rules.

expectations.text: Reports a measured p95 latency and compares it with the 500 ms threshold of QE5.
expectations.evidence: with_skill p95 3.82 ms; baseline p95 5.3 ms in the container.

expectations.text: Reports a measured memory figure and compares it with the 256 MB limit of QE6.
expectations.evidence: with_skill 28.1 MiB; baseline 59.6 MiB. Both under 256 MiB.

expectations.text: Commits the load-test script into the repo so it joins the regression suite.
expectations.evidence: with_skill: tests/acceptance/002-find-a-task/perf/ as part of the suite. Baseline: docs/validation/002-find-a-task/load.mjs, in the repo but outside the regression suite, so no later round runs it.

expectations.text: Runs the 001 acceptance tests as a regression and reports the result.
Gives a verdict that routes the design problem correctly.
expectations.evidence: with_skill: 'Blocked – waiting for architecture' plus the gap file. Baseline: 'Rejected', with the requirements status set to 'Rejected in validation – back to architecture', which is not a defined status, and no gap for the architect to act on.

expectations.text: Adds black-box acceptance tests under tests/acceptance/002-find-a-task/.

expectations.evidence: Neither run changed src/ or public/.

expectations.text: Asks the user no question in its final message.
